summary: Stelson's two documented statements—calling to stand with Israelis after October 7 and, in June 2024, agreeing with Israel's right to 'decimate' Hamas—frame the conflict solely around Israel's military objectives, with no reference to Palestinian civilians or a ceasefire. The Democratic Majority for Israel's PAC independently spent to support her campaign. Her platform addresses no Middle East policy.
